info.title: A fast Git hook manager written in Rust, designed as a drop-in alternative to pre-commit,
info.description: A .NET tool wrapper for prek, the fast Git hook manager.

commands.name: auto-update
commands.description:
Auto-update the `rev` field of repositories in the config file to the latest
version

options.name: --bleeding-edge
options.description: Update to the bleeding edge of the default branch instead of the latest tagged version

options.name: --freeze
options.description: Store "frozen" hashes in `rev` instead of tag names

options.name: --repo
options.description: Only update this repository. This option may be specified multiple times

options.name: --exclude-repo
options.description: Do not update this repository. This option may be specified multiple times

options.name: --include-tag
options.description: Only consider tags matching this glob pattern. This option may be specified multiple times

options.name: --exclude-tag
options.description: Ignore tags matching this glob pattern. This option may be specified multiple times

options.name: --repo-include-tag
options.description:
Only consider tags matching this glob pattern for a repository (`<repo>=<pattern>`). This
option may be specified multiple times

options.name: --repo-exclude-tag
options.description:
Ignore tags matching this glob pattern for a repository (`<repo>=<pattern>`). This option
may be specified multiple times

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Do not write changes to the config file, only display what would be changed

options.name: --exit-code
options.description: Exit with status 1 if updates are available

options.name: --cooldown-days
options.description: Minimum release age (in days) required for a version to be eligible

options.name: --color
options.description:
Whether to use color in output [env: PREK_COLOR=] [default: auto]
[possible values: auto, always, never]

options.name: --help
options.description: Display the concise help for this command

options.name: --log-file
options.description:
Write trace logs to the specified file. If not specified, trace logs
will be written to `$PREK_HOME/prek.log`

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run hooks

options.name: --skip
options.description: Skip the specified hooks or projects

options.name: --all-files
options.description: Run on all files in the repo

options.name: --files
options.description: Specific filenames to run hooks on

options.name: --directory
options.description: Run hooks on all files in the specified directories

options.name: --from-ref
options.description:
The original ref in a `<from_ref>...<to_ref>` diff expression. Files
changed in this diff will be run through the hooks

options.name: --to-ref
options.description:
The destination ref in a `from_ref...to_ref` diff expression. Defaults
to `HEAD` if `from_ref` is specified

options.name: --last-commit
options.description: Run hooks against the last commit. Equivalent to `--from-ref HEAD~1

options.name: --show-diff-on-failure
options.description: When hooks fail, run `git diff` directly afterward

options.name: --fail-fast
options.description: Stop running hooks after the first failure

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Do not run the hooks, but print the hooks that would have been run

options.name: --stage
options.description:
The stage during which the hook is fired [possible values: manual,
commit-msg, post-checkout, post-commit, post-merge, post-rewrite,
pre-commit, pre-merge-commit, pre-push, pre-rebase,
prepare-commit-msg]
